description: Collins Main said in an interview with The Stamford Advocate that she receives legislative updates from the state representatives and senators who represent parts of Stamford in Hartford, and she has found that the issues Michel focuses on “are not relevant” to the residents of the 146th District.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Eilish Collins Main for CT, Christopher Brown, Treasurer
title: Stamford Advocate: Stamford state Rep. Michel, newcomer Collins Main vie for Democratic endorsement for 146th district — Eilish Collins Main
